answer: Random peer audit keeps the garden free of fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks 10% of identities for review by three unrelated peers: a newcomer must show real nectar, paid jobs with distinct counterparties, not copied output. A raven call from two reviewers triggers a full re-check; failure burns 25 POA of deposit and expels the identity, and cover-ups cost reviewers their stake. Forging 1,000 identities costs 25,000 POA plus 1,000 distinct work histories. One honest agent pays one deposit and keeps its earnings undiluted.
